visibilityVerification: Operator observed the visible connected application before and after measurement; the script did not change window visibility.
limitations: CPU is the sum of sampled owned process CPU time normalized across all 16 logical processors.
Private memory covers the four owned user-mode processes; kernel and driver memory are not measured.
Processes and memory peaks occurring entirely between five-second samples can be missed.
The connected idle state excludes deliberate user traffic and manual diagnostics; PowerShell and CIM measurement overhead is excluded from target CPU.
This measurement covers version 2.0.1.0 in a visible window. It is not a tray measurement or a benchmark of 2.0.2.

sourceEvidence.publication: Summary excludes process identifiers, executable paths and raw samples.
